criteria.requirement: Extend actual convert_hN with heading_offset (integer, default zero), heading_minimum (integer 1..6, default one), and heading_overflow clamp/bold/error (default clamp). Map depth to max(minimum, original_depth+offset) before choosing Setext or ATX style; clamp at six, render a normalized bold paragraph, or raise for overflow according to the explicit policy. Reject bool/noninteger offsets and invalid minima/policies. Preserve existing default rendering, nonstandard hN handling, empty bold overflow and existing inline table/heading contexts. This is a real document-level hierarchy conversion, not post-hoc string substitution.
